name: Diabetes
description: A laboratory test of HbA1c, which reflects average blood glucose over the previous two to three months.
sample: Finger-prick blood sample collected at home
result_time: Newfoundland quotes 2–5 working days for laboratory results. Follow the timing supplied with your kit.
limitations: HbA1c is a longer-term measure. It does not show your blood glucose at this moment or explain every symptom.

name: Heart Health
description: A laboratory lipid panel covering several cholesterol measures and triglycerides, giving more detail than the total-cholesterol self-test.
sample: Finger-prick blood sample collected at home
result_time: Result timing will be confirmed when this test launches.
limitations: These blood markers are one part of the picture. This is not a complete assessment of your heart or a test for acute chest symptoms.

name: Male Hormone
markers_json: ["Testosterone","Free testosterone","Luteinising hormone (LH)","Follicle stimulating hormone (FSH)","Oestradiol","Prolactin","Sex hormone binding globulin (SHBG)","Albumin"]
description: A laboratory panel of hormones and related markers, including total and free testosterone, LH, FSH, oestradiol, prolactin, SHBG and albumin.
sample: Finger-prick blood sample collected at home
result_time: Result timing will be confirmed when this test launches.
limitations: A hormone panel needs the right sampling and clinical context. One result does not establish a diagnosis or mean you need testosterone treatment.

name: Cholesterol
description: A finger-prick self-test that uses a colour chart to show the band your total cholesterol falls into. Read the result at home.
sample: Finger-prick blood sample collected at home
result_time: Around 2 minutes; read the colour chart within the window in the kit instructions.
results_access: Read at home using the kit instructions
limitations: This self-test checks total cholesterol. It does not provide the separate HDL, LDL and triglyceride results of the Heart Health lab panel.

name: Thyroid
description: A finger-prick self-test for TSH, used as an indicator of a possible underactive thyroid.
sample: Finger-prick blood sample collected at home
result_time: Around 10 minutes. Follow the reading window in the kit instructions.
results_access: Read at home using the kit instructions
limitations: This is not a full thyroid panel. A self-test result needs appropriate medical follow-up and does not explain every cause of tiredness or weight change.

name: Iron
description: A finger-prick self-test for ferritin, a protein associated with stored iron. The result is read at home.
sample: Finger-prick blood sample collected at home
result_time: Around 5 minutes. Follow the reading window in the kit instructions.
results_access: Read at home using the kit instructions
limitations: A ferritin self-test is not a full blood count and cannot investigate every cause of anaemia or tiredness.

name: Vitamin D
description: A finger-prick self-test that checks vitamin D and lets you read your result at home using the supplied guide.
sample: Finger-prick blood sample collected at home
result_time: Around 10 minutes. Follow the reading window in the kit instructions.
results_access: Read at home using the kit instructions
limitations: Follow the supplied result guide. A self-test alone does not determine which supplements or doses are suitable for you.
